notes: Fixed: the panel on your desktop was not picking up changes to a layout you had already applied. It read the saved layouts once when it opened, so editing a layout and pressing Use left it drawing the version from when the panel started…
A layout now reaches the panel the moment it is saved, deleted, reordered or applied, and the panel redraws even when the layout kept the same name.
The layout maker has the layer controls: the base fill and the gradient scrim that carries contrast over your wallpaper, adjustable beside the strip they affect rather than in another window.
The maker preview draws those layers too, so what you are adjusting is visible while you adjust it.
